title: Stellar Braid Monodromy of Finite-Rank Non-Gaussian Photonic States
summary: Finite-rank non-Gaussian bosonic states admit a holomorphic description in the Bargmann representation: after a zero-free Gaussian factor is separated off, their non-Gaussian structure is encoded by a finite stellar divisor. This article introduces a topological refinement of stellar rank for regular parameterized families of such states. Rather than only counting the zeros of the stellar divisor, we follow their motion under deformations of the state and record the associated braid monodromy.
